title: Mundelein Park Board President Bob Knudson honored for 15 years of service
text:
← Back to the wire
Mundelein Park Board President Bob Knudson honored for 15 years of service
Mundelein Park & Recreation District Board President Bob Knudson was honored with a plaque recognizing his 15 years of service. The board expressed gratitude for his leadership and commitment during a recent meeting.
Mundelein Park & Recreation District Board President Bob Knudson was recognized on Oct. 14 for 15 years of dedicated service during a board meeting. Knudson received a plaque from the Illinois Association of Park Districts in acknowledgment of his milestone.
The district thanked Knudson for his leadership and commitment, stating, "Thank you, President Knudson, for your hard work, leadership, and commitment to helping our District shine and grow. We are grateful for the time and dedication you’ve given to making our community a better place!"
Knudson's tenure has been marked by efforts to improve the district and support its growth. The recognition highlighted his ongoing contributions to the community.
The meeting concluded with congratulations on his 15 years of service and an expression of gratitude: "Congratulations on 15 years of service, and thank you for all you do!"
